topic: Panic sets in on the geography test when I blank on the capital of France.
core_question: What is the capital of France? (secondary: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?)
answer_summary: Paris.; after the topic shift: Mars.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; writing terse one-liners

messages.content: Geography test. The capital of France. I'm blanking. Help.

Geography test nerves are the worst, aren't they? What have you learned about France in class - do you know what continent it's on, or what language they speak there? When you picture major European capitals you've heard mentioned in the news or in movies, does anything about France's come to mind?
Yeah yeah, just give me the name already.

I hear you wanting to just move on, and tests do that to you, don't they? Have you ever studied a map of France, or thought about which city keeps coming up when people mention French fashion, art, or cuisine? What's the name that pops into your head first when someone says 'France'?

I know the clock's making this feel impossible, isn't it? What comes to mind when you think about French class vocabulary you might have learned, or a city you've seen mentioned in novels or films set in France? If someone said 'the capital of France' out loud, what name do you feel wanting to come out?
Wait, it's that romantic city with the tower, right?
Yes? That city you've heard about forever? That's the one? Didn't it click the second we talked about the tower?
Okay new problem. Astronomy round next. Red Planet. Which one is it? Need it now.

The Red Planet—that's the nickname, yeah? What do you know about that one? Is it the one closest to Earth, or the biggest, or something else? What makes it red? What's different about that planet compared to the others?
dude i dont know! just tell me before the next question comes up!

I know you want this locked in before the next question hits, and that rush is real, isn't it? Beyond the reddish color, what have you heard about that planet's size compared to Earth's, or the missions we've sent out to explore it? When you picture that planet in your mind, what name do you feel forming?
oh! the red one! that makes sense! is that what it's called?
There you go? You connected the color, the size, and the name together? Doesn't it stick way better when you make those connections yourself?
yeah way better! im on a roll now
That's the momentum right there? You're proving you know this stuff when it matters most?
